We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the substitution reaction: replace leaving group (hydroxyl) with halogen. Input data: from previous step make_6_lvl2-apply_template-2 answer: '[["CNOC", "O=C(O)c1ccccc1"]]' So applying some template to target molecule gave precursors: "CNOC" and "O=C(O)c1ccccc1". The target molecule must be something that results from combining these precursors via a template. The target molecule likely is "CNOC(=O)c1ccccc1"? Wait the precursors: CNOC (maybe methyl carbamate? Actually CNOC is maybe "C N O C"? That's "C N O C" maybe "C N O C" is "C N O C"? Could be "C N O C" = "C N O C"? Not sure. And O=C(O)c1ccccc1 is benzoic acid. The template likely forms an ester: combine benzoic acid with CNOC to form "CNOC(=O)c1ccccc1". That is an ester of benzoic acid with N-methylhydroxyl? Actually CNOC is maybe "C N O C" which is "C N O C" maybe "C N O C" is "C N O C"? Could be "C N O C" = "C N O C"? Might be "C N O C" is "C N O C"? Not important.

Now the task: find template that when applied to the molecule (the product) reproduces the reaction: substitution of hydroxyl with halogen. So the product after substitution would be something like "ClC(=O)c1ccccc1"? Wait substitution of leaving group (hydroxyl) with halogen on the carbonyl? Actually typical substitution: convert alcohol to alkyl halide. Here we have an aliphatic hydroxyl group being replaced by halogen. In our molecule, the leaving group is the O of the CNOC group? Actually the molecule "CNOC(=O)c1ccccc1" has an O attached to carbonyl (ester). The leaving group is the O of the CNOC? The substitution would replace that O with halogen, giving "CClC(=O)c1ccccc1"? Not sure.

But we need to search template catalog for a template that breaks C-O bond and forms C-X (halogen). The functional groups broken: aliphatic hydroxyls. Formed: alkyl halide. We attempted search but got empty. Maybe need to use functional_groups_broken: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"] and functional_groups_formed: ["alkyl halide"] but result empty. Could be template ID not found. Maybe need to search with bonds broken/formed using correct format: bonds_broken: ["6-8"]? Not sure.

Alternative: Use get_template? We need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). We don't know ID. Could retrieve template list via search with broader criteria. Maybe search for functional_groups_broken: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"] only.
